ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_marginexp_advantage_costgap_weighted_loss
ir.intuition: Exponentially penalize small margins formed by preference difference scaled by combined cost and advantage gaps, with epsilon and clamping for numeric stability.
ir.pseudocode:
eps=1e-6
pref_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
combined_signal = cost_gap + advantage_gap + eps
clamped_margin = clamp(pref_diff * combined_signal, max=20)
loss_terms = weight * exp(-clamped_margin)
loss = mean(loss_terms)

hyperparams.other_hparams: epsilon=1e-6 for numerical stability, margin clamped max 20 to avoid overflow

ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
    log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    pref_diff = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)
    combined_signal = ops.add(cost_gap, ops.add(advantage_gap, eps))
    margin_raw = ops.mul(pref_diff, combined_signal)
    margin = ops.clamp(margin_raw, max=20.0)
    loss_terms = ops.mul(weight, ops.exp(ops.neg(margin)))
    loss = ops.mean(loss_terms)
    return loss
